page.overview:
Who is Annaline?

is a human weretiger. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

When first encountered by Bells Hells, Annaline was in the form of a wide-shouldered deep red-orange weretiger standing six and a half feet tall and carrying a massive iron-headed hammer. She wore dark grey-brown hide armor and a jet black hood. In her human form, she was a woman in her late 40s with short dark red hair with gray streaks, an intense expression, and a severe, perpetually clenched jaw.

In her past life, before she became a lycanthrope, Annaline's name was Divaasheela. She was a student at the Dayal Hall in Jrusar and therefore knew the Dayal family. She was sent to retrieve a mislabeled delivery from her uncle in the northeast Oderan Wilds when she was attacked by a lycan (which she suspects was connected in some way with the Ivory Syndicate). When the curse found her, she left the city, took the name "Annaline", and was trained in the ways of the Gorgynei by Ometho, one of the founders of the group.

She told Chetney if he ever encountered the lycan who transmitted the curse to her, a pale, brown-haired elf named Dorao with amber eyes and a scar under his mouth to the left, Chetney should kill him immediately for her.
